name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 72.7 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Potrebujem 3 karte za jutri zjutraj.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Nas je 5, vključno z 2 otrokoma.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: Moja telefonska številka je 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: Let traja 9 ur in 25 minut.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Nas je 4 in imamo 6 kovčkov.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: Soba 214 je v drugem nadstropju.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Prispel sem 3. oktobra in odhajam 9. oktobra.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: Ob kateri uri se muzej odpre ob nedeljah?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: Moj vlak odpelje ob 18:45 s perona 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Zadnji avtobus odpelje ob 23:30 nocoj.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Imam rezervacijo ob 20.00 za 2 osebi.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: Ali se lekarna odpre pred 9. uro zjutraj?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Ogled se začne ob 14:15 in traja 3 ure.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: Zajtrk postrežejo od 6:30 do 10:00.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Koliko stane dvoposteljna soba za 3 noči?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: To stane 45 evrov, vključno z davkom.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Ali obstaja popust za 2 odrasli in 1 otroka?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: Vozovnica stane 12,50 evra na osebo.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Lahko 78 evrov plačam s kartico?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Koliko stane avtobus na letališče za 2 osebi?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Dnevni meni stane 15 evrov, pijača je vključena.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Naslov je Calle Mayor 15, tretje nadstropje.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Moj hotel je na Gran Vía 28, blizu podzemne železnice.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Veleposlaništvo je na Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Prosim, zapišite naslov: številka 42, stanovanje 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Mesto srečanja je Plaza del Sol, vhoda 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Je to pot do Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Kje je najbližje avtobusno postajališče?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Na semaforju zavijte levo in nato pojdite naravnost 200 metrov.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: Se da od postaje do hotela priti peš?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Katera linija gre na letališče, linija 5 ali linija 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Oprostite, ali je to sedež 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Kako pridem od tod v staro mesto?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Muzej je od trga oddaljen približno 15 minut hoje.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Prosim, pokličite rešilca, nekdo je nezavesten.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Izgubil sem potni list in denarnico.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Kje je najbližja bolnišnica ali klinika?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Sem alergičen na arašide; ali ta jed vsebuje arašide?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Nekdo mi je ukradel torbo z 200 evri notri.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Prosim, pokličite policijo. Zgodila se je nesreča.
